findings.title: The red check copies test:browsers instead of reading it from package.json, so the two can drift apart
findings.why: bothSuites hardcodes `node tests/two-browser.mjs; node tests/two-browser.mjs --relay` instead of running each `&&` part of package.json's test:browsers. If test:browsers gains a run or a flag, the red check silently tests something different from `npm test`. Right now the two match, so nothing is wrong today.

findings.title: The new runner-lib tests match source text, not behaviour
findings.why: The first test regex-matches the exact shell string. A semantically identical rewrite fails it, and a wrong exit expression (for example `exit $r`) would still pass it. The second test only checks for no `&&` after expansion, so it doesn't check that the exit status combines all three results. A small exported helper that builds the command and combines the exit codes, with a test of its own, would check what matters.
